paragraphs: GetInsured sells software as a service for public sector health care. The company frames the work around a single goal, which is access to affordable coverage for every American. Its implementations run in ten state-based marketplaces around the country.

Consumers use a portal whether they are browsing plans without an account or managing coverage inside one. Someone can start anonymously and then create an account in the same session without re-entering what they already typed. State and support staff work in a separate administration portal showing consumer information, enrollment data and history, ticket history and ticket status. Assisters and navigators get their own portal, where they can see and interact with the Consumer Portal just as the consumer does, including uploading documents for DMIs.

The company names marketplace work in Idaho, Illinois, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Georgia and Virginia. Oregon is described as launching for plan year 2027. It also counts 4.5 million people migrated from Healthcare.gov.

quote.text: GetInsured’s mission is to enable access to affordable health insurance for every American
